svg.text: Make three. Structural tube 88.9 x 3.2 mm, yield at least

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 310 MPa, cut 4,364 mm long, ends square. Not water pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End caps: 8 mm discs, 100 mm across, welded on both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tongues: 60 x 90 x 16 mm plate, one welded to the middle of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each cap, in line with the tube; the two tongues lie in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: same plane. 21 mm pin hole 60 mm from the cap face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin hole to pin hole: 4,500 mm. Set it in a jig.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg 1: weld the winch bracket (WSL-DWG-104) before galvanising.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 10 mm vent hole near each end; galvanise.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: pin centres 4,500 mm apart within 3 mm; leg straight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: within 5 mm; all three legs the same length within 2 mm.
